curiosities.text: The Moon drifts away from Earth about 3.8 cm every year.
On the Moon, you would weigh about one sixth as much.
Voyager 1 reaches one light-day from Earth on 18 November 2026.
Mars has two little moons, called Phobos and Deimos.
Pioneer 10 was the first spacecraft through the asteroid belt.
Eagle landed near 0.67 degrees north, 23.47 degrees east.
No wind here, so footprints can stay for a very long time.
The seismometer sent about three weeks of moonquake data.
Opportunity landed in Eagle crater, only about 22 metres wide.
Opportunity's top speed on flat ground was 5 cm a second.
A day on Mars lasts about 24 hours and 40 minutes.
